name: East Dunbartonshire
title: East Dunbartonshire —
title_em: the West Highland Way starts here.
tagline: From Milngavie's West Highland Way start to the Campsie Fells.
summary: East Dunbartonshire lies north of Glasgow, with Bearsden, Milngavie, Kirkintilloch and Lenzie. Milngavie is the starting point of the 96-mile West Highland Way.
The Forth and Clyde Canal runs through Kirkintilloch, and the Antonine Wall can still be traced at Bearsden.
